locator_detail: Olson Table A.5, row O15a, sample 218m
reviewed_fact: Table A.5 reports O15a on clear 9.525 mm PMMA rod sample 218m, with calibrated oxygen 17.1% initially and 16.7% finally. Airflow started at 5 cm/s and extinction occurred at potentiometer setting 0.32. Endpoint airspeed and run pressure are unreported.

locator_detail: Olson Table A.5, row O15b, sample 218m
reviewed_fact: Table A.5 reports O15b on clear 9.525 mm PMMA rod sample 218m, with calibrated oxygen 16.7% initially and 15.6% finally. Airflow started at 5 cm/s and extinction occurred at potentiometer setting 0.27. Endpoint airspeed and run pressure are unreported. This was a reburn of O15a's rod.

locator_detail: Section 6.1, Figure 6.4 Staged-Flow PMMA Sequence (printed pp. 69–71)
reviewed_fact: Figure 6.4 shows five airflow plateaus, read approximately as 4.5, 2.1, 1.5, 1.1 and 1.0 cm/s. The prose reports 14.8% initial and 13.6% final oxygen. Intermediate oxygen is unreported.
At the end of the staged airflow reduction in BASS-II Figure 6.4, oxygen concentration reached 13.6%.

locator_detail: NTRS 20150008961, Section 2 & Table 1: 24-Test ISS Concurrent-Flow PMMA Cohort and Companion Drop-Tower Tests
reviewed_fact: NTRS 20150008961 defines the 24-test ISS concurrent-flow PMMA rod cohort distinguishing low-flow radiative quenching from high-flow blowoff, alongside separate short drop-tower tests.

locator_detail: NTRS 20170008805, Saffire-I sample 1-1 and Table I
reviewed_fact: Sample 1-1 was a 40.6 x 94 cm SIBAL sheet aboard uncrewed Cygnus. It burned for 420 s at 20 cm/s concurrent airflow, spread at 1.8 mm/s on average and extinguished after scheduled airflow shutoff.

locator_detail: Meyer et al. (2018), Table 1, ISS Kapton run 62
reviewed_fact: Kapton run 62 count-mean particle diameter increased from 0.180 to 0.235 micrometers by microscopy and from 0.148 to 0.243 micrometers by the aerosol moment method, at 38.8 and 807.6 s of net aging.

locator_detail: NASA/TP-2015-216046, Table IX and Figures 174 and 206, runs 171 and 203
reviewed_fact: Free-floating methanol runs 203 and 171 at 21% initial oxygen and near 1 atm used 0% and 15% CO2. Their reported extinction diameters were 1.42 and 1.59 mm. Run 171 started with a larger droplet and its extinction diameter came from a fit across missing observations. Both ended in diffusive extinction.

locator_detail: NTRS 20250010653, shared chamber and material results
reviewed_fact: A 4 mm acrylic rod and SIBAL fabric burned together in normal-pressure air aboard a rotating New Shepard rocket at simulated lunar gravity. Flame-tip spread rates were 1.5 mm/s for acrylic and 1.1 mm/s for fabric. Oxygen readings apply at chamber level. Numeric chamber pressure is unreported in the presentation.

locator_detail: NTRS 20240003211, Table 1 Recommended Crewed Lunar Exploration Atmosphere (8.2 psia, 34% O2)
reviewed_fact: NASA recommends a cabin exploration atmosphere assumption of 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) total pressure and 34% oxygen for lunar surface rovers and habitats.

locator_detail: NTRS 20240003211, Table 1 Recommended Crewed Lunar Exploration Oxygen Concentration (34% O2)
reviewed_fact: The recommended exploration atmosphere specifies 34% oxygen by volume at 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) total cabin pressure.

locator_detail: Section 4, Partial-Gravity Flammability Minimum & Buoyant Convection Crossover
reviewed_fact: Flammability limits in partial gravity (such as lunar 1/6 g) can extend beyond both microgravity and 1 g boundaries because moderate buoyant convection supplies oxidizer faster than 0 g diffusion without imposing 1 g blowoff strain.
